purpose: One bounded GINO screen against the completed six-family 480-update screen; no new Hash refinement and no old solver reruns

prerequisites.release: Root reviews source and freezes training_rules_frozen before the sole actual training job
prerequisites.resource_limit: Completed lower-frequency official modes12 full179316 input/512 outputs and target-independent backward; does not certify matched modes24/24/22, full-output2048 chunks or other CADs

recipe.optimizer_implementation: Torch Adam foreach=True,fused=False, preserving original complex spectral parameters and its view-as-real Adam update
recipe.loss: Complete-case mean MSE in existing TRAIN-only encoded signed uXYZ/stress4; each original-node query chunk weighted by its count/N before one Adam update
recipe.case_schedule: Exactly the existing cache's four independently shuffled TRAIN120 passes from Python Random(2026); model RNG does not select cases
recipe.gradient: Encode full original case once, replace only differentiable latent by an independent leaf, accumulate all query losses/output parameter and latent gradients, then original latent.backward(leaf.grad) once
recipe.selection_score: 0.5*(VAL15 case-mean physical U-vector relative L2 + case-mean signed-stress relative L2)
recipe.primary_readout: Fixed480 endpoint and observed error-versus-comparable-train-seconds curve; validation-best retained separately, no training-best selection
recipe.output: Signed displacement XYZ in mm and signed source scalar stress in MPa after unchanged shared FieldScaler.decode
recipe.precision: float32 with TF32 as existing screen; no autocast; exact stored-coordinate radius distance computed/cached float64

model.architecture: Original input/output GNO kernels and half_cos, original lifting/FNO/projection, shared live PointNetglobal32 concatenated to all latent voxels
model.frequency_match: Existing FNO m12 retains x/y24 total and real-FFT z12; official modes24/24/22 resolve to x/y24 and real-FFT z12. This is the sole GINO screen candidate, no low-frequency companion or mode search.
model.training_parameter_counts: Measure public actual matched-model counts at its first released construction, complex tensors counted by numel; do not reuse lower-frequency counts
model.capacity_limit: Retained frequency bands, hidden16 and four layers match the old FNO screen, but original lifting/spectral/skip implementations differ. Report actual parameter count and costs; this is not exact capacity matching and any difference cannot be attributed solely to learned GNO kernels.

radius_cache_policy.cross_load_reuse: Every CAD shares canonical xyz/node order across ver/hor/tor; exact geometry CSR constructed at most once per completed CAD cache
radius_cache_policy.first_CAD_reuse: Reuse the existing101_479 pilot's complete eight NPY inventory; no repeated construction
radius_cache_policy.other_CADs: On-demand regular_grid_radius at R64/radius0.033; persist both complete orientations and grid_axis/grid_xyz, keep only active CAD on device
radius_cache_policy.exact_neighbors: No drop/cap/sample/clipping/dense cdist or radius/grid/query chunk fallback
radius_cache_policy.empty_rows: Latent empties retained; original point coverage required without invented neighbors
radius_cache_policy.costs: Actual build/read-H2D/save seconds, counts and unique cache bytes separate; total wall includes all operations

metrics.global: Existing all-original-node physical U/S case means, worst cases and stress hotspots on TRAIN3 and VAL15
metrics.BC_regions: Seven exact source feature0:7 ==1 regions; each region counts and U-vector RMS mm/stress RMS+MAE MPa/relative errors with explicit zero-reference nulls. Regions may overlap; source support-reference DOFs are not hard node Dirichlet equations.
metrics.pass_costs: Every120 updates: cumulative/incremental comparable train seconds, mean per-case seconds, separate cumulative CSR build/read/save; all five endpoints retain mean/worst and full-case physical metrics
metrics.timing_fairness: Primary train_seconds begins before load_case like the old screen and includes case/target H2D and cached CSR IO, excluding only first construction/save; extra gpu_step_seconds reports synchronized model-update spans. Inference timing starts after input/CSR loading like the old screen; evaluation/totalwall retain frontend costs.
metrics.memory: Observed peak allocated/reserved only; no extrapolated full-dataset or output-training feasibility claim

resume: Atomic last/best and each endpoint checkpoint; last also at first update and every30 updates. Preserve Adam, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG, complete ordered schedule, next position, exposures, pass costs/history and geometry contracts. Failed full case preserves last committed checkpoint.
failure_policy: A real complete-case OOM/nonfinite fails explicitly; no silent node/radius/neighborhood/query-chunk reduction or repeated probe

access.evaluation: Existing5developmentVAL x ver/hor/tor and fixedTRAIN3 only
access.author_execution: One AST/stdlib metadata source-check; no arrays, labels, weights, model construction or GPU
access.actual_execution: Sole root queue after source review and recipe freeze; no toy, warmup, install or clone

limitations: Early screen at one recipe/seed, not convergence or architecture elimination
Empirical radius mean/mollified sum is not FEM volume integration, stiffness or exact BC/PDE enforcement
Already-used final cases do not guide this cycle; newly acquired independent test labels remain sealed
Resource acceptance covers lower-frequency modes12 one input/512 outputs only; first actual matched-frequency complete case determines larger-model/full-output feasibility
